title: animateScrollToItem 迁成 scrollToIndex，对齐用 ScrollAlign.START

triggers.read: 源端 lazyListState.animateScrollToItem(index)，同一处还调顶栏的 collapse()
triggers.wrong: 目标写 scrollToIndex(index, true, ScrollAlign.CENTER)，或漏了顶栏收起

scope: 把 Compose LazyListState 的滚动定位迁成 ArkUI List 的 Scroller 时

how.text: 写成 this.scroller.scrollToIndex(index, true, ScrollAlign.START)，目标项滚到列表顶部
源码同时 collapse 顶栏时一并实现收起；做不到就登记为偏差

values.value: scrollToIndex(value: number, smooth?: boolean, align?: ScrollAlign, options?: ScrollToIndexOptions)
values.meaning: 滚到指定下标；容器是 List 时 align 默认 ScrollAlign.START，smooth 默认 false

values.value: ScrollAlign.START：列表项的起始边与列表起始边对齐；ScrollAlign.CENTER：列表项在主轴居中
values.meaning: 源端滚到顶部对应 START

values.value: scrollToItemInGroup(index: number, indexInGroup: number, smooth?: boolean, align?: ScrollAlign): void
values.meaning: 同族接口：ListScroller 滚到分组内的项

why: 写成 CENTER 时目标项停在列表中部，和源端滚到顶部不一致

probe.note: 滚动后居中；核对源端是不是 animateScrollToItem（应滚到顶部，用 START）

siblings_checked: 搜 ScrollAlign 作参数：Scroller.scrollToIndex、ListScroller.scrollToItemInGroup 两个，后者写进 values

refs.quote: scrollToIndex(value: number, smooth?: boolean, align?: ScrollAlign, options?: ScrollToIndexOptions);

refs.what: List 容器的 align 默认 START
refs.quote: Default value when the container is List: ScrollAlign.START
The start edge of the list item is flush with the start edge of the list.
The list item is centered along the main axis of the list.
scrollToItemInGroup(index: number, indexInGroup: number, smooth?: boolean, align?: ScrollAlign): void;
